source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 5 June 1964, p. 4 ("Rural council results: North Down"); Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4 (North Down nominations)
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 5 June 1964, p. 4 (North Down: 'Miss S. P. Beckett, 486; Alfred A. Turkington, 140'); the nominations report of 20 May 1964, p. 4 names the sitting member Miss J. P. Beckett, Portavogie.

note: Triennial election of North Down Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Contests and unopposed returns are reported, but the only division whose result is printed with a member's name in the report read is Ards Peninsula, where a withdrawal left a walk-over. Seventy-two per cent poll. No party labels printed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Belfast Telegraph, 5 June 1964, p. 4 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the results print 'Miss S. P. Beckett' (kept as printed), but the nominations report (BT 20 May 1964, p. 4) and the 1952 return name the sitting member Miss J. P. Beckett, so her name is recorded as J. P.
